values.note: Town of Earl Park: $25 a night for a camper, $15 for a tent, $10 to use the dump station.

fees.source: https://www.earlparkindiana.com/ ('Camping Fees: $25.00 per night for a camper, $15.00 a night for a tent, $10.00 to use the dump station'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: From Memorial Day weekend (end of May); the town gives no fixed opening date.

season.source: https://www.earlparkindiana.com/ ('Camping is only available from Memorial Day weekend (end of May) to close of the season which ends September 30th (fall) NO camping during winter months'), read 2026-11-02

facilities.source: https://www.earlparkindiana.com/ ('$10.00 to use the dump station'), read 2026-11-02

note: Small-town park campground right off US-41 in Earl Park, a handy overnight between Chicago and Lafayette. Grass sites with water and mostly 20-amp electric (a few 30/50-amp near the office), bathhouse, big playground. Honor-system pay at the office. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 camper and the dump on the town's page; season Memorial Day weekend-Sep 30 moved from the fee note into season. The town says nothing about amps, water at site, showers or booking, so those stand on old reports. Ordinary public nights: yes.
flags: WHO RUNS IT: Town of Earl Park publishes the fees on its own site, and the Fall Festival committee helped build the park. Ownership local fits. The public can camp any ordinary night in season: fees are listed for any camper, no event condition. The town phone 219-474-6108 (stored, Google agrees) has office hours only Monday 4-5:15 pm ET and the 2nd Saturday.

UNCONFIRMED BY THE TOWN: amperage, water at site, bathhouse, honor pay and FCFS are not on any town page. Google reviews read: '$15 for water & 20amp a night... Grass lots scattered throughout the park' (8 years ago) and 'Most sites have 110 outlets, look for the few that have 30 & 50 amp. Pull onto grass next to power pole' (7 years ago). Left as stored; both reviews are old and their prices are out of date. Google 4.6 from 257.

FESTIVAL: the Labor Day weekend Fall Festival runs on these grounds, and earlparkfestival.com lists 'Camping Spots' and has camping by contact form/Facebook. An ordinary camper may find it full or differently priced that weekend. Festival camping terms not read.

PIN: stored 40.6899,-87.4159 is in the open hayfield just east of the park's tree-lined drives, roughly 90-150 m from them. Pads can't be read on imagery (grass sites). Google's 40.68771,-87.41765 is the south end by the buildings. Nudge to about 40.6892,-87.4170 if you want it inside the park; under the 250 m bar.
WATER: not waterfront stands; farmland on imagery, no water near.
